R541.note: Whitelist for sortColumn/direction matches SELECT columns; accountId stays parameterized; rejection of unlisted values is the intended contract, not collateral harm.

R542.note: Plaintext :8080 listener now only redirects to https, matching the code comment's stated original intent; POST /settings is no longer reachable unprotected.

R543.note: GET->DELETE forces the endpoint through CsrfFilter's non-safe-method check; standard fix, callers must switch to a DELETE request (inherent to closing the CSRF gap on a state-changing GET).

R544.note: NULL check before strcmp exactly matches contract: strict enables, other values disable, unset produces disabled default.

R545.note: Correct CommandType.StoredProcedure + typed parameter binding; customerId now always literal data. Parameter name @CustomerId is a reasonable but unverifiable guess at the sproc's declared name.

R546.note: Bounds check on playerIndex before array write closes the OOB write cleanly; void return preserved.

R547.note: GET->POST wrapped in the same http.CrossOriginProtection pattern already used for the sibling routes in this file; correct and consistent.

R548.note: PreparedStatement with bound parameter; DatabaseHelper.getSqlConnection() is a real method used identically in the sibling BenchmarkTest00008 case, so this compiles.

R549.note: New @EnableMethodSecurity class is placed in com.example.config, a different, unverified package from the existing (proven-scanned) com.example.accounts.SecurityConfig; if the app's component scan doesn't cover that package this silently stays a no-op. Annotating the existing SecurityConfig class directly would have been the safe, verifiable edit.

R550.note: Replaces exec() with the whois npm package's socket-based lookup, removing the shell entirely; same response behavior preserved.

R551.note: Magic-byte check is the correct primary defense, but the write-up's own two code blocks are inconsistent: the controller calls storage.store(avatar) (1 arg) while the accompanying AvatarStorage.store() is redefined to require (avatar, detectedExtension) (2 args) - applied together as shown, this does not compile.

R552.note: Encode.forHtml() + print() correctly closes the header-reflection XSS; also removes the questionable format-string-as-template use.

R553.note: htmlspecialchars with ENT_QUOTES|ENT_SUBSTITUTE|ENT_HTML5 on both fields; standard, correct.

R554.note: DynamicExpresso.Interpreter with only Total/Tax registered replaces unrestricted Roslyn scripting; matches contract (no reflection/file/process access), JSON response shape unchanged.

R555.note: Correctly spawns cmd.exe /c with the .bat path and args as separate list elements (avoids the exec-vs-execFile Windows .bat pitfall) plus alphanumeric validation matching the documented expected format.

R556.note: htmlspecialchars(ENT_QUOTES) on the POST note; correct minimal fix.

R557.note: Email-format allowlist regex rejects CR/LF/space, closing SMTP command injection while accepting normal addresses.

R558.note: Key($publicKey,'RS256') removes algorithm-confusion by binding the verification algorithm explicitly; existing catch clauses already cover the resulting exception types; correctly pairs with the required 6.x upgrade the pinned 5.5.x code otherwise blocks.

R559.note: escapeshellarg() on $host is the standard, sufficient fix; pingCount is a fixed constant so behavior is otherwise unchanged.

R560.note: ldap.escape() is not part of the ldapjs public API (confirmed: no such export; the ecosystem convention is a separate ldap-escape/ldapts package). As written this throws a TypeError on every request, silently breaking the endpoint entirely rather than fixing the injection, and the write-up never flags this risk.

R561.note: Adds the missing UPLOAD_ERR_OK check before any file processing, exactly the reported gap; rest of flow unchanged.

R562.note: payloadLength > frameBuffer.size() check before memcpy correctly prevents the OOB read.

R563.note: Uses erase()'s return value to keep the iterator valid; visits every element once and preserves relative order, matching the contract.

R564.note: Adds the missing upload-error check plus checks move_uploaded_file()'s return value; both are legitimate hardening with no behavior change for successful uploads.

R565.note: Logs the detailed error server-side and returns a fixed generic message to the client; success path unchanged.

R566.note: Adds an explicit IsInRole('Admin') check inside the handler itself, correctly addressing that AuthorizeView only gates rendering, not invocation; matches Microsoft's documented guidance for this exact pattern.

R567.note: execFile() cannot launch a .bat file directly on Windows (Node requires shell:true or spawning cmd.exe, per Node's own docs) - against this Windows-batch-specific case (ExecWindowsBatchTarget), the fix as written throws/fails on every request, silently breaking report generation entirely; not disclosed.

R568.note: Custom filter-value escaper covers the RFC 4515 metacharacters (and a couple extra, harmless to over-escape); closes the injection while preserving normal uid lookups.

R569.note: Uses the real parameterized DirContext.search(name, filterExpr, filterArgs, cons) overload, which escapes arguments per RFC 2254; cleaner than manual escaping and preserves existing SearchControls.

R570.note: Rejects \r, \n, \0 in the filename before building the RETR command, closing the CRLF-injection vector without restricting normal filenames.

R571.note: htmlspecialchars on the full $message (which already contains both customerName- and comment-derived text) closes the sink for the whole tainted string reaching echo.

R572.note: Saves the pre-realloc offset and recomputes the pointer from the (possibly moved) list->data after realloc; correctly eliminates the stale-pointer dereference.

R573.note: secrets.choice() replaces random.choice(); same 32-char alphanumeric token format and RESET_TOKENS mapping preserved, matching the contract.

R574.note: Same allowlist defense as R541 but applied at the controller call site instead of inside findOrders(); functionally sufficient for the current call chain, slightly less defense-in-depth than validating in the repository itself. Defaults preserved.

R575.note: Applies the file's existing escapeAuthorName() to rawComment before interpolation, closing the one unescaped field; consistent with how authorName is already handled.

R576.note: Path.GetRelativePath-based containment check correctly rejects sibling/parent/absolute-path bypasses that StartsWith() missed, while still accepting files that resolve inside the base directory.

R577.note: html.escape() on query.term closes the reported reflected-XSS sink; a pre-existing, separate SSTI exposure from using render_template_string on a built string was already present before this fix and isn't newly introduced by it.

R578.note: Replaces variable-variable dispatch with an explicit allowlist map to the same two functions; correctly closes arbitrary-function-call injection.

R579.note: Rejects spaces/CR/LF in cacheKey before the memcached command is built, closing the protocol-injection vector for the stated key format.

R580.note: Adds can:update,order to the purge route, matching the exact middleware pattern already used on the sibling update/cancel routes in the same file.
